summary: In community.docker, the docker_container image_name_mismatch default changed from ignore to recreate.
questions: Why is docker_container recreating my container after upgrading?
How do I keep containers when the image name differs?

answer_card.title: docker_container image_name_mismatch default
answer_card.answer_md: `docker_container`'s `image_name_mismatch` now defaults to `recreate` (was `ignore`). Set `image_name_mismatch: ignore` to keep the old behavior.
